content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face significant barriers when trying to sell their products online due to restrictions from platforms like Lemon Squeezy. These platforms operate under a model that excludes a vast majority of the global population, limiting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-everything-you-need-2|Payment Options]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-4|options]] for creators. With Stripe only available in 46 of the 195 countries globally, many find themselves unable to process payments effectively. This post explores robust infrastructure alternatives that empower creators without relying on conventional payment processors that restrict access.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy offers a user-friendly interface for selling digital products, but it operates within a restrictive framework that doesn't account for creators in many countries. This means that while it provides features like automatic delivery and payment processing, users in restricted regions are left out entirely. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto|COREMERCH guide to complete]] stack that allows creators to build and operate their online stores independently. With tools such as Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, creators can set up a fully functional store that supports crypto payments and maintains complete data ownership, avoiding reliance on platforms that limit access.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms often cite compliance and regulatory issues as reasons for excluding certain countries from their services. This results in creators being unable to monetize their work effectively. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these restrictions by leveraging decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments, which does not require KYC and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This approach not only allows creators from restricted countries to sell their products but also protects them from sudden account suspensions or freezes, which are commonplace with traditional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processors like PayPal and Stripe impose high fees and transaction rates, often sacrificing speed for compliance. PayPal, for instance, can hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, creating a cash flow nightmare for creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack are designed to minimize costs with low transaction fees (0.5% with NOWPayments) and instant payment confirmations. This means that creators can access their funds immediately upon sale, enabling them to reinvest in their businesses without delay.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full data ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a significant concern when utilizing traditional platforms, as creators often don’t have full control over their data or customer relationships. Lemon Squeezy retains certain rights over user content, which can be detrimental. On the other hand, with the Edge Commerce Stack, creators own their entire infrastructure after deployment. This includes all customer data, product files, and store configurations. Automation through integrated services ensures that once set up, the store runs smoothly with minimal manual intervention, allowing creators to focus on what they do best: creating.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries looking for viable alternatives to Lemon Squeezy, the decision hinges on the need for autonomy and accessibility. If you require a rapid deployment with minimal setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid entry point. However, for those wanting more advanced features and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a robust solution with a full suite of tools, end-to-end testing, and configuration support. This architecture not only meets immediate needs but also prepares creators for future growth without the looming threat of platform restrictions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the pitfalls of payment freezes with decentralized payment options.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by assessing your product offerings and digital assets. Next, choose the appropriate stack based on your needs, such as the Edge Commerce Stack for more features. Set up your store using Cloudflare Pages and integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Upload your digital products and configure automated delivery settings. Finally, test the entire system to ensure smooth operations before launching.
